sec: sec:C009: Enable real-time feedback and intervention / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:C009: Enable real-time feedback and intervention / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Enabling user intervention capabilities. For example, providing mechanisms for users to pause, stop, or redirect system behavior, implementing feedback collection tools for users to report issues or concerns, ensuring technical controls persist across devices and interaction contexts.

sentences.text: For example, providing mechanisms for users to pause, stop, or redirect system behavior, implementing feedback collection tools for users to report issues or concerns, ensuring technical controls persist across devices and interaction contexts.

blocks.id: blk:C009: Enable real-time feedback and intervention / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Ensuring accessibility of feedback and intervention mechanisms. For example, adhering to WCAG 2.1 standards for color contrast, screen reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, and clear messaging for users with disabilities.
